summary: LLM API pricing in late 2026 spans a wide range, from sub-$0.20 per million input tokens for lightweight models to $15+ for flagship models like Claude Opus. Prompt caching and batch discounts (typically 50% off) are now standard across major vendors, and mid-tier models like GPT-4o, Gemini 2.5 Flash, and Claude Sonnet cluster around $0.30–$3 per million input tokens, offering strong price-performance. Note that some live research references newer model generations (GPT-5.x/6.x, Gemini 3.x), but the pricing below reflects the specific models requested with confirmed published rates on official vendor pages.

models.name: GPT-4o
models.notes: Batch API offers 50% discount. Cached input priced at half of standard input. Rate limits scale by usage tier.

models.name: GPT-4o mini
models.notes: Lowest-cost mainstream OpenAI model; Batch API provides an additional 50% discount.

models.name: Claude Sonnet 4.6
models.notes: Prompt caching reads at ~10% of input price; cache writes cost more. Batch processing offers 50% discount.

models.name: Gemini 2.5 Flash
models.notes: Free tier available (Google may use content to improve products). Batch requests at half price. Context caching supported.

models.name: Gemini 2.5 Pro
models.notes: Higher input price (>200K token prompts) tiered upward. Batch requests at half price. Free tier with data-use terms.

models.name: o4-mini
models.notes: Reasoning model; output includes reasoning tokens. Batch API 50% discount available.

models.name: o3
models.notes: Advanced reasoning model; output tokens include reasoning. Pricing reduced from launch; batch discount applies.

models.name: Claude Haiku 4.5
models.notes: Fastest, lowest-cost Claude model. Prompt caching and 50% batch discount supported.

models.name: Claude Opus 4.8
models.notes: Flagship, highest-capability Claude model. Cache reads ~10% of input; batch processing 50% discount.

models.name: Grok (grok-4)
models.notes: Pricing tiered by context length; cached input discounted. Available via xAI API.

models.name: Mistral Large
models.notes: Flagship Mistral model; free experimentation tier available via La Plateforme. Batch discounts offered.

models.name: Mistral Small
models.notes: Cost-efficient Mistral model; free tier available on La Plateforme.

models.name: Llama (hosted via Together AI)
models.notes: Open-weight Llama models hosted by Together AI; pricing varies by model size (e.g. Llama 3.3 70B). Free credits for new accounts.

models.name: Llama (hosted via Groq)
models.notes: Groq offers very high-throughput inference for Llama models; pricing varies by model. Free tier available.

models.name: Llama (hosted via Fireworks AI)
models.notes: Fireworks hosts Llama models with serverless pricing by parameter size. Free credits for new users.

models.name: Command R+
models.notes: Cohere's flagship RAG-optimized model; free trial API keys available with rate limits.

models.name: DeepSeek V3 (deepseek-chat)
models.notes: Very low-cost model with off-peak discounts; cache-hit input heavily discounted. Pricing varies by UTC time windows.
